name: Tower of Orthanc
game_text:
To play, spot an <culture>Isengard</culture> minion.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot an exhausted companion to add <twilight>3</twilight>.
flavor_text: “‘It was not made by Saruman, but by the men of Númenor long ago; and it is very tall and has many secrets; yet it looks not to be a work of craft.’”
